title: Lamb: The Gospel According to Biff, Christ's Childhood Pal
author: Christopher Moore
summary: Biff, Jesus's fictional boyhood friend, is revived to write the missing years of his life. He recounts their travels in search of wise men and the youth of a Messiah who is learning who he is.
readIf: you enjoy irreverent comic novels and do not mind religion being gently mocked.
skipIf: you would be uncomfortable with jokes about Jesus and Christian belief.
